page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6r.xlarge is an ARM-based compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the Ampere Altra processor. It features 4 dedicated physical cores running at 2.8 GHz with a single thread per core, delivering a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 8.0 GB of system memory. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local NVMe storage or dedicated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is established with a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate average performance for multi-core and single-core CPU operations via stress-ng, alongside average uncached memory bandwidth write speeds of 31.38 GB/sec. However, the instance exhibits weaker performance in memory-intensive tasks, single-threaded compression, and cryptographic operations, with Passmark CPU encryption scoring in the bottom 10%. Text processing, image processing, and software compilation benchmarks also fall into the lower performance tiers, while database operations maintain an average rating.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ARM64 architecture provides a resource-dense hardware profile suitable for organizations seeking dedicated CPU resources without the overhead of hyperthreading. Due to the lack of local storage and moderate memory capacity, this instance is best suited for lightweight containerized microservices, static web serving, basic database operations, and development workloads that do not require high-performance cryptography or extensive memory bandwidth.
